ledger: 00:00-00:09: Driver's truck outside diner — white aerodynamic high-roof sleeper-cab semi-tractor (bobtail, no trailer/box, tandem rear axles) parked next to the diner.
00:19-00:26, 00:36-00:44, 01:00-01:08, 01:18-01:26: Parked vehicle visible through left diner window — white front hood and bumper facing the window.
01:41-01:49: Driver's truck outside diner — dark green conventional-cab straight box truck with a white horizontal stripe, vertical chrome exhaust stacks, attached cargo box, and single rear axle.
01:50-01:58: Parked vehicle visible through left diner window — reverts to the white vehicle front hood/bumper in the same position.

findings.description: The truck parked outside the diner initially appears at 00:00-00:09 as a white high-roof sleeper-cab semi-tractor with no trailer (bobtail), with its white front end visible through the diner window throughout the scene. When the driver exits the diner at 01:41 to get into his truck outside the window, it has inexplicably transformed into a dark green and white conventional-cab straight box truck with chrome exhaust stacks and an attached cargo box.
